newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia Jan-Oct trade surplus falls 49.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia Jan-Oct trade surplus falls 49.2 pct.

text.p: Mongolia registered a trade surplus of $43.5 million in January-October, down 49.2 percent from $85.7 million in the same period a year ago, official figures showed on Friday.
Exports in January-October dropped to $396.5 million from $402 million in the year-ago period while imports in the period rose to $353 million from $316.3 million, the State Statistics Bulletin said.
Mongolia posted a trade surplus of $13.9 million for October alone compared with a $840,000 trade deficit in October 1995, the report said.
Mongolia had a trade surplus of $8.5 million in September, the report said.
October exports were $47.2 million, up from $44.1 million last year, while imports were $33.3 million, down from $44.9 million, it said.
